English: Wild Olive Stand
A cluster of wild olive trees maintained by nomads, providing a basic source of olives and shade for the camp. Useful for subsistence and modest clan gatherings.
Clay Press Hut
A simple clay hut sheltering a primitive olive press. Allows for basic oil extraction and supports a slightly larger nomadic population.
Stone Trough
A sturdy stone trough improves oil extraction, increasing yields and providing for the clans needs. Also allows for trade of surplus oil.
Timber Press Pavilion
A wooden pavilion housing more advanced presses, enabling substantial olive oil production and increased clan prosperity.
Oil Storage Room
A secure, stone-built storage chamber preserves olive oil for trade, ritual, and sustenance, greatly enhancing clan unity and reputation.
Expanded Orchard
Cultivated olive groves stretch across the land, yielding abundant oil, making the clan a center of prosperity and regional influence.
Merchants Olivehouse
A dedicated merchants olivehouse serves as a hub for trade caravans, boosting clan prestige and ties with foreign traders.
Walled Grove
A fortified olive grove, its walls safeguarding valuable resources and ensuring the clans continued prosperity and security.
Oil Market Pavilion
A grand pavilion for the oil market draws traders from afar, cementing the clans role as a regional power and center of unity.
Jewish Olive Estate
A sprawling, renowned Jewish olive estate with extensive groves, advanced presses, storerooms, and market halls, famed throughout the region for both piety and prosperity.
